inemaseo-pratica.titulo: inemaSEO in practice: the method in 10 steps

inicio.titulo: Foundation: the X-ray and the groundwork of your site
inicio.lead: Before you write any new page, look at your site the way a search engine does. In eight lessons you run a read-only X-ray, verify your site in Search Console and Bing, set the canonical, sitemap, and robots.txt right, take thin pages out of the index, and notify the search engines. All free, with open scripts.
inicio.capa_alt: The owner of a small ceramics workshop looks closely at her notebook screen, sitting at the work table.
inicio.aulas_sub: In the order of the work: understand, look, verify, fix the address, the map, and the door, clean out the thin pages, and notify.

itens: Website owners or small business owners who have never worked with SEO.
People who already have a live site but don't know whether Google and Bing can see the pages.
People who have heard about "showing up in AIs" and want to know what is fundamental and what is a fad.

blocos.t: What you'll be able to do
itens: Run a read-only X-ray on your site and read what it shows.
Verify your site in Search Console and Bing Webmaster and submit the sitemap.
Set one canonical only, a sitemap with real dates, and a robots.txt decided by purpose.
Take thin pages out of the index and notify the search engines only with URLs that return 200.

blocos.t: Where this course fits in the inemaSEO Program
itens: 1 Foundation (this course): the technical foundation. Without it, no content pays off.
2 Content and 3 Measurement: the pages only you can write and the number that matters, the one for searches without your brand.
4 In AIs, 5 With Agents, and 6 Professional: official AI panels, agents doing the repetitive work, and SEO as a service.
All of them follow the inemaSEO method, open (MIT), applied on the portal, the news site, and the events site of INEMA.

cursos.sub: From the foundation of your website to your own open Semrush. Take them in order or jump straight to what you need right now.

itens.t: Foundation: the X-ray and the groundwork of your site
itens.l: In eight lessons you run a read-only X-ray, verify your site in Search Console and Bing, set the canonical, sitemap, and robots.txt right, take thin pages out of the index, and notify the search engines.

itens.t: Content: pages only you can write
itens.l: In eight lessons you declare your entity, separate territories, validate your content plan for free, write pillar pages and listing pages with real data, link everything together, and learn what not to do.

itens.t: Measurement and Routine: the number that matters is the non-branded one
itens.l: In eight lessons, you separate the brand, read URL Inspection, decide when to change a title, turn queries into a topic list, test another language, set up the conversion goal, and build the routine with a Plan B.

itens.t: In the AIs: AEO, GEO, and sites used by agents
itens.l: In eight lessons you separate fundamentals from fads, read the official dashboards, measure citations by hand every month, fix your entity, check the bots in the log, and get your site ready for agents.

itens.t: With Agents: Claude Code and Codex Doing the Repetitive Work
itens.l: Audit, extract, apply in batches, check, and report: the repetitive part of SEO fits in an agent that runs through your subscription.

itens.t: Professional: selling and delivering SEO + AI as a service people can trust
itens.l: In eight lessons you learn to sell diagnosis, plan, measured follow-up and teaching, instead of position 1 or 500 articles.

itens.t: Systems: build your own open Semrush
itens.l: Five open, free terminal tools that do for your site what the paid suites do: a full-site audit, an AI readiness score, Search Console history, Bing AI citations, and AI bots in the log.
